title: label-write --handoff: review paging, login case, ACCEPT author, exit-2 reading and a stale header (nits left by #35948's reviews)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35948 (PR #36214, `label-write --handoff`). The nits its two contract reviews left untaken, in one place so none is lost (records 7075527312 and 7076207941). Filed by the seat. Parent: #35948.

## What is left
1. **One page of reviews.** `reviews-list` reads one page of 100; an approver whose review sits on a later page reads uncovered and is requested again. Harmless direction (a repeat request), but the reading is incomplete.
2. **Login case.** `handoffReviewPlan` matches approver logins case-insensitively while H43 matches exactly. With a mis-cased entry in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, the plan reads covered and H43 reads ✗, so a dry run can take the "already handed off" exit 0 beside a `now H43 ✗` line, against the header's "exit 7 when a `now` row reads ✗". One comparison rule for both.
3. **ACCEPT author.** The ACCEPT is read from any commenter (H43's existing reading); only the PASS is author-bound. Decide whether the ACCEPT should be bound to the seat that claims the card, and pin whichever is chosen.
4. **Exit 2 means two things.** As the per-round reader (`execution-duties.md` line 17), exit 2 covers both "nothing is owed" and "a piece is missing before the rows can fire" (no ACCEPT, an ACCEPT older than the head, no same-head PASS). Line 17 names only exit 7, and a head that moved after a hand-off (the case line 16 exists for) reads 2. Either split the exit or have line 17 say that any non-zero exit is read by its sentence.
5. **Stale header sentence.** The `label-write.mjs` header says `governedReviewPlan` reads the `.claude/**` row path-only and would request nobody; that is `main` before `b78b14cc` (PR #36215). Reword it.

## Done when
Each item is fixed with a pin, or recorded on this card as an accepted deviation with its reason. Item 4 touches governed rule text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`), so that part takes the skill-face review.

Blocked-by: #36214 (the hand-off mode must be on `main` first)

## Grade
p3 · area:fleet · domain:devx. Fleet tooling edge cases; no product behaviour.
